thumbnails.concept_ko: 3분할 승패: 마감된 뉴욕 시험장 / 경탄하는 미국 청년 / 빛나는 한국 대학과 큰 태극기
thumbnails.prompt_en: Triumphant epic cinematic HDR photograph, high saturation, split into three zones. Left, small and in cold desaturated shadow: a wintry Manhattan street, a test-center door with a red 'FULL' sign and a line of multinational young adults in coats, a small ordinary American flag in the top-left corner. Center: an anonymous young American woman in her twenties, chest-up close-up, jaw-dropped and awestruck, looking and pointing toward the right side. Right, larger and closer to the camera in a heroic low-angle shot: a Korean university main gate blazing with golden backlight, glowing rim light, lens flare and sparks, and a huge Korean flag Taegukgi waving proudly in sunlight in the top-right corner, filling at least a quarter of the frame height.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 3분할 승패: 비어 가는 미국 대학 외국어 강의실 / 놀란 교수 / 학생으로 가득 찬 한국어 강의실
thumbnails.prompt_en: Victorious cinematic HDR photograph, high saturation, three-part composition. Left, in dim cold low-saturation light: a half-empty American university foreign-language lecture hall with rows of vacant seats, a small plain American flag in the top-left corner. Center: an anonymous American professor in his fifties, chest-up, eyes wide in amazement, turning to look at the right side. Right, bigger and closer in a heroic low-angle shot: a bright lecture hall packed with students of many nationalities studying Korean, Hangul visible on the board, bathed in golden backlight with glowing rim light and lens flare, a huge Korean flag Taegukgi waving proudly in sunlight in the top-right corner, at least a quarter of the frame height.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 3분할 승패: 베트남 졸업시험장 / 토픽 성적표를 든 베트남 고3 / 빛나는 한국 캠퍼스
thumbnails.prompt_en: Triumphant epic cinematic HDR photograph, high saturation, split into three zones. Left, cool and muted: a Vietnamese high-school graduation exam hall with rows of desks, a small ordinary Vietnamese flag in the top-left corner. Center: an anonymous Vietnamese high-school senior, chest-up close-up, proudly holding up a TOPIK score certificate, face full of awe as she looks toward the right side. Right, larger and closer in a heroic low-angle shot: a sunlit Korean university campus glowing with golden backlight, rim light and sparks, a huge Korean flag Taegukgi waving proudly in sunlight in the top-right corner, filling at least a quarter of the frame height.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 영웅샷: 한국어 시험장으로 끝없이 이어진 다국적 응시자 줄과 거대한 태극기
thumbnails.prompt_en: Epic triumphant cinematic photograph at dawn, heroic low-angle shot from the front of the line. An endless line of hundreds of young test-takers of many nationalities, some in hijabs and some in winter jackets, stretches toward a Korean-language exam hall whose doors pour out golden light, glowing rim light and lens flare. A huge Korean flag Taegukgi hangs and waves proudly in sunlight on the building facade, at least a quarter of the frame height. The applicants at the front look up at the building in awe. High-saturation HDR, victorious mood.

thumbnails.concept_ko: 영웅샷: 황금빛 캠퍼스로 걸어 들어오는 다국적 유학생들
thumbnails.prompt_en: Victorious epic cinematic HDR photograph at golden hour, heroic low-angle shot. A grand Korean university campus gate towers over the frame, blazing with golden backlight, rim light and sparks, while a crowd of international students of many nationalities walks in through the gate with backpacks, smiling and looking up in admiration. A huge Korean flag Taegukgi waves proudly in sunlight above the gate, filling at least a quarter of the frame height. High saturation, triumphant atmosphere.
